Message:
Prisma-dump import script + transfer API docs (ticket B3, part 2)

scripts/import-prisma-dump.ts: a plain pg_dump --data-only (COPY blocks) or
the live DATABASE_URL_OLD into the new schema through MikroORM upserts on the
old ids, parents first, one transaction. --dry-run prints counts per table
and every unmappable row; the first mapping failure exits 1 unless
--continue (which also skips dependent rows). Pokemon transfer columns are
never overwritten on re-import. Sessions are not imported.

Mappers, COPY/array parsers and the CLI live in src/modules/transfer/import
and are unit-tested against fixtures built from the old init migration's
column list; a metadata test pins every persisted entity column to a mapper.
README documents the /api/internal/transfer contract and the import.
